title: pilosella × bifurca subsp. praticola
intro: Pilosella × bifurca subsp. praticola, commonly known as a variant of the false oxeye daisy, is a rare plant species known for its unique characteristics. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine, offering potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate conditions like arthritis and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant are primarily attributed to its ability to modulate immune responses, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of Pilosella × bifurca subsp. praticola include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
